in_sanskrit.name: Gaveshan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Giver of Treasure
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gaveshan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gaveshan is derived from Sanskrit words ‘gave’ meaning 'giver' and ‘eshana’ meaning 'treasure'. This name is bestowed upon a child who is believed to bring wealth and prosperity to the family.
